notes.title: New Update: Version 10.60.0
notes.content:
Shadow Arena, Minotaur Super Raids, quality of life updates, and more!
 

Update 10.60.0 is here, bringing with it a bunch of updates to various game modes. We’re introducing a Shadow Arena mode for Platinum Tier, Super Raids for the Minotaur’s Labyrinth, and a whole lot more quality of life updates that we hope will make your RAID experience that much better. Check out everything that’s coming below. 

Shadow Arena
To offer a more diverse and competitive experience in Platinum Tier Classic Arena, we're introducing a new feature – Shadow Arena – inspired by community feedback and aimed at creating a more exciting competition. This limited-time mode will hide all information about opponents until the Classic Arena weekly reset, meaning players will not be able to see who they are fighting against and team up with Clan allies.


Minotaur Super Raids & Quality of Life Updates
We’re introducing time-limited Super Raids to the Minotaur’s Labyrinth, and an indication that shows which Champions have already earned the maximum number of Scrolls they need to unlock all of their Masteries. With this “MAX” indication, it’ll be clearer for players to know who they should switch or remove from the team.

We’re also making sure that if you’re running Background Multi-Battles or Auto-Battle in the Minotaur’s Labyrinth and all Champions in the current team have reached the max number of scrolls, the current sequence of battles will end automatically to prevent players wasting unnecessary Energy.


Selling Equipped Gear
When managing your Gear, we’re replacing the option to destroy equipped Gear with the ability to sell or remove it instead. You’ll now be able to sell equipped Gear directly from a Champion’s loadout, or through the Gear Filter menu.


Doom Tower Quality of Life
We’ve introduced some quality of life updates to the Doom Tower, meaning Presets can be saved across different Rotations of the Doom Tower.


Clan vs Clan Points Update
The CvC Points multiplier will now no longer appear once you’ve reached the Points cap for that Objective type. Also, we’re adding multiplier labels to the Game Modes menu to highlight areas of the game where you can earn extra points in the active CvC Tournament. This feature will be made available in-game with the next CvC launch.


Clan Shop Items Distribution
We’ve redistributed some of the resources you can earn from the Clan Shop, such as making Gilded Medallions available to Clans at earlier Clan Levels.


Champion Filter in the Sparring Pit
Champions that have already reached Max Level will no longer appear when selecting a Champion for the Sparring Pit.


Guardian Ring Quality of Life
We’ve introduced a quality of life update for the Guardian Ring which prevents the game from resetting the list of Champions when you’ve previously scrolled down and unselected a Champion.


Champion Filter Stat Range Quality of Life
We’re introducing stat ranges when filtering Champions. Now, you’ll be able to sort through your Champion Collection to find Champions with specific amounts of certain stats like Speed or Critical Rate.


Gear Filter Improvement
We’ve improved the Gear Filter, so now you can filter Gear by the number of Substat upgrades. For that, simply choose a Substat in the Filter Menu and select an option.


Enable Notifications
We’ve improved the ability to receive notifications from the game by adding more clear information regarding notifications in the Profile window.


Siege Mana Shrines Improvements
We’ve made a tooltip in the Siege Battle Phase that shows how many Rebattle attempts are available in Mana Shrines. Also, we’ve added a notification when Rebattle attempts are available, along with a reminder to set Building Bonuses.


Advanced Quests Rebalance

notes.title: New Update: Version 10.55.0
notes.content:
Update 10.55.0 is here, bringing an expansion and new feature to Siege, as well as improvements to Clan Quests, Faction Guardians, the Tavern, and more. There are also some significant changes coming to the Chimera. Check out everything that’s coming below.

Siege Expansion
As part of the expansion coming to Siege, we’re introducing Tiers 7 and 8. There are new conditions to get into these new Tiers, as well as awesome rewards like Avatar Frames. We’re also introducing more Levels, Groups, and Team Slots for each Building, and we’ve reviewed the balance of Florins required to repair and upgrade Buildings. You’ll receive more Mana Orbs for protecting your Stronghold and Mana Shrines, destroying your enemy’s Stronghold, and rebattling previously-defeated Defense Teams in Mana Shrines. Lastly, we’re making it so that Clan Leaders can now remove a Clan member’s Defense Team from a Slot.

Siege Traps
The second major addition to Siege is Traps. Players now can add Traps to their Defense Teams during the Prep Phase. Traps provide a variety of unique effects, such as hiding one of the defending Champions or denying enemy healing. Placing a Trap costs Florins and Mana Orbs. Check out the Siege Guide to learn more.

Faction Guardians Improvement
We’re adding an option for you to Commission your Faction Guardians. This action permanently saves the Guardian Chamber’s bonus and frees up space in your Collection by removing the Champions from your account.

Clan Quest Update
The Clan Quest requiring you to survive 150 turns or more in a Hydra Battle on Brutal Difficulty or above is being made easier. From now on, you'll only need to last 100 turns.

Tavern Update
Rank Chickens and Feasts will now be stacked in the Tavern window to reduce unnecessary overcrowding. Also, Champions in the Vaults will be available when using the Instant Rank-Up feature. 

Advanced Quests Update
We’ve also added new Advanced Quests and an option to refresh some of the Quests in order to help you complete the ones you like. Look for new additions with the Quests' refresh at 00:00 UTC.

Due to popular demand, we've updated the reward for the "Win 3 Artifacts/Accessories from clearing the Dungeons" Advanced Quest. Upon completing this Quest, you’ll now receive a 1-hour Free Gear Removal Booster, delivered to your Inbox with a 24-hour expiration time.

Chest Rewards
We're introducing a new Chest Rewards tab, available both in the Battle Info menu and the end-of-battle window, which will be updated for Clan Boss battles. It will clearly show whether the damage you've dealt is enough to earn a Reward Chest.

AI fixes
We have addressed AI bugs across a wide variety of locations in the game. Check out the full list of skills, Champions, and Bosses that have been affected in the news post titled A Smoother Game Awaits: AI Bugs Fixed.

Chimera Rebalance
In short, we’re making the Ram Form a little bit easier to fight, and the Lion Form is becoming a bit more menacing. We’ve also adjusted some of the Trials for all Forms as well. For more details read the associated news post.

Artifact Chest Rebalance
The chances of obtaining more valuable Artifacts have increased. The drop rates were adjusted based on Rank/Rarity, while the Set types remained unchanged. The following chests were affected:

Exquisite Artifact Chest

Magnificent Artifact Chest

Elite Dragon Artifact Chest

Elite Ice Golem Artifact Chest

Elite Fire Knight Artifact Chest

Tag Arena Leagues Size QoL

The capacity of the Silver and Gold Tiers in Tag Team Arena has been increased.

notes.title: New Update: Version 10.50.0
notes.content:
Update 10.50.0 is here, and brings with it a bunch of updates. We’ve got a brand-new global event, Chaos Awakes, as well as the return of the Event Dungeon, new Champions, new Relics, and much more. Check out everything that’s coming with this update below.

New Champions
With this invasion of Demonspawn, new Champions have made their grand appearance in the fight for Teleria. There’s the mastermind behind the invasion, Kurosa the Covetous, as well as her Legendary lackeys, Gracchos Turn-drake and Balar the Lost. Next up is our resident anti-hero Dwarf, Tholin Foulbeard, who hunts evil wherever it roams. And stay tuned for a Legendary Sylvan Watcher Champion, Leminisi the Gold-wing, who’ll join the fight a bit later on. Jump in-game now to check them out and read their unique lore via the Champion Lore button. 

Collect all 4 Legendary Champions before 5 August 23:59 UTC to earn a special gift containing an Avatar Frame, the Skull of Treason Relic and other valuables. Collect all 5 new Champions at any point to earn the Chaos Awakes Badge and show off your achievement!

Chaos Awakes Event Dungeon
Take up arms against the fearsome leader of the Demonspawn forces that have invaded Teleria - the Mythical menace herself, Kurosa the Covetous. Venture into the Event Dungeon and receive exclusive Gear for winning Stages.

Coalition Event
Fight back against the forces of darkness in Chaos Awakes with a brand-new type of Event in Raid - the Coalition Event. Team up with other players from around the world to complete Quests, rack up Points, and earn amazing rewards.

Leminisi Chase
Just when all hope seems lost, a Legendary Sylvan Watcher will leap into the fray to help save the day! Leminisi the Gold-wing will be available later on in the Chaos Awakes event for all players to claim after logging in for 7 days, and you can claim her Perfect Soul after logging in for another 7 days. After that, complete specific objectives to earn further rewards!

New Relics
8 powerful new Relics have been added to the game. They can be crafted using Twysted Horns, which can be earned throughout smaller Events and Tournaments that are part of Chaos Awakes. Use the power of the Demonspawn against them to stand against the forces of darkness.

Oil & Extract Mixer
Utilize your excess Oils & Extracts with the Oil & Extract Mixer. Swiftly combine low-tier resources into high-tier ones and Ascend your Gear!

notes.content:
While hordes of Demonspawn led by Kurosa prepare to sneak into Teleria through mysterious portals and spread chaos, we keep maintaining stability: what can be more stable than our regular #RAIDDigest. Let’s dive in! 

⚔️ Live Arena Seasons Points & Matchmaking Changes

With the start of the next LA Season, we’ll be rolling out some updates to Live Arena Seasons Points, and matchmaking.

The first change is that the number of Season Points gained or lost in a battle will be adjusted.  It will depend on the point gap between you and your opponent. To put it briefly, when defeating a considerably weaker opponent, you’ll get fewer points; when losing a battle to a much higher-ranked player, you'll lose fewer points.  

The second change is that we are improving the matchmaking system of the Live Arena Seasons to decrease the chances of a match between accounts with a considerable difference in Season Points. 

All the details are coming next week in the corresponding in-game news, so stay tuned. 

Hard Faction Wars Challenge “Manipulate buff or debuff duration 20+ times”: Nuances 

Decreasing Bombs' duration doesn't count for the Hard Faction Wars challenge “Manipulate buff or debuff duration 20+ times” (for example, Glishak’s A2), as this particular effect [Bomb] is related to 'detonation' and not 'decreasing duration'. 

The same situation applies to the Poison and HP Burn Activations (for example, Artak, Dark Kael)—the “force tick”  does not count towards the Challenge because it doesn't reduce the duration of debuffs; it literally activates them. 

Another nuance you probably need to know about the Challenge is that it counts the number of effects triggered (Decrease/Increase duration or Decrease/Increase cooldown), not by how many turns the effect manipulated buffs/debuffs or skills.

 Here is an example:

 Let’s say there are 5 Champions in a battle, and each one has 2 Debuffs. 
 When you increase the duration of all Debuffs, it might seem like you’ll get 10 ticks of progress. But what actually counts toward the Challenge is the number of successfully triggered effects. 
 In this example, since the effect triggered on 5 Champions, that means 5 successful procs — which equals 5 points of Challenge progress.
 This is the same for reducing/increasing skill cooldowns

🛠️ Bugs And Fixes 

 There is a nasty bug that causes Siege Preset slots for the Defense Team to disappear after deleting the preset that was assigned to the slot. The fix is planned for the nearest release. In the meantime, feel free to reach out to our Support team for help in removing the teams. 
 After reaching the Silver, Gold, or Platinum Clan League, players get the same notification repeatedly every time they visit the Clan window (Congratulations!). It should only be shown once. The bug will be fixed in one of the next releases. 
 The Aspect of Siroth Relic prevents the activation of Rotos the Lost Groom’s Spurn Oblivion skill when receiving fatal damage. We will fix it in the next release. 

⚔️Clan vs. Clan Tournament and Personal Rewards

Sharpen your blades — the next installment of the Clan Tournament will come with Personal Rewards. 

🎨By the way, the #WhatsBeneathTheHelm Fan Art Contest is live on our social media (Facebook, X aka Twitter, Instagram, Reddit); it may be a good opportunity to show your drawing skills and win Shards, Gems, and even a cool Hegemon avatar. notes.title: RAID Digest (16.05.25)
notes.content:
Hello, Raiders! While some of you are trying the teeth on the Hard Mode of Faction Wars and others are just enjoying the spring vibes, we’ve prepared another issue of RAID Digest for you, in which we will mainly cover the recent updates. Without further ado, let’s start!

Faction Wars: Hard Mode 
As you know, the Hard Mode of Faction Wars was recently released in RAID. By the way, Hard Mode Challenges are available during battle in the Pause menu.

We don't want to impose too many limitations on players when exploring the Hard mode of the Faction wars. Thus, the Advanced Quests "Beat 1 Faction Wars Stage with at least 1 Rare Champion on your team" and "Win 3 Faction Wars Battles without losing a Champion" have been permanently removed. 

Progressive Chance Event with 2 different Unity Champions. How does it work? 
During Progressive Chance Events, all Unity Champions are added to the Shard pool with their normal drop rates. Selecting one Unity Champion for the boosted chance does not remove other Unity Champions from the pool, but x15 multiplier is applied only for the Champion chosen in the active slot.

Rework of Instant Poison/HP Burn Activation Effects
The new effect is a rework of Instant Poison/HP Burn activation and will 'affect' four Champions: Zavia, Elenaril, Karam, and Polara.

After the rework, the poison damage will now benefit from Poison Sensitivity, the Lethal Dose blessing, and any relics, stones, or passives that enhance or reduce Poison damage, including those that add ignore effects like Stokk's. For example, with Zavia, her damage used to be calculated as Max HP damage. The number of poisons would be counted, their turn durations considered, removed, and converted into damage—which was then reduced by the 10% passive effect on Bosses. Now, her damage will be affected by passives that cut Poison damage by up to 90%, but overall, with the added bonuses, the numbers should still be much higher.

Champions that activate Poisons/Burns like Teodor or Gizmak in 1st form, won't be changed. They will still make a 1 tick of 1 turn of poison/burn.

Leaderboards Avatar Frames
Some of you might have already noticed Leaderboards Avatar Frames in the game. That’s just a spoiler, they will become truly available later, with the release of the Leaderboards.

Bugs and Fixes

 There is a known visual bug affecting Artifact selling, where the sold Artifact remains on the screen and results in an error when attempted to be sold again. We plan to fix it in the near future. In the meantime, clearing RAID application cache should resolve the issue.
 Cancel opponent search button doesn't work in Live Arena. We are investigating the problem. We will keep you informed.
 Right now Ash’nar Dragonsoul does not extend Debuffs other than HP Burn. That is incorrect behaviour. The fix is planned for the next big update.
 Using a Champion with the Relic Torch of Thralldom may cause a battle loading longer than usual. This is a known problem, and we are actively monitoring the situation. We will keep you updated.

Clan vs Clan Tournament  and Personal Rewards
The next installment of Clan vs Clan Tournament won’t feature Personal Rewards.

Update 10.40.0 is here, bringing Artifact Quick Craft, improvements to Siege and Relics, a new type of Tournament related to Gear Ascension, rebalances to Chimera Clan Quests, and more! Check out everything that’s coming below.

Relic Improvements

We’re adding Relic Lore which can be found in the Relic Index. We’re also separating the Events Group into several themed groups for better understanding. First of these groups is the Alice’s Adventure Group, and there will be more Groups in the future when Relics are released as part of specific Events. We’re also implementing minor improvements in Relic Storage and Gemstone Storage, such as highlighting compatible Relic sockets when selecting a Gemstone.

Artifact Quick Craft and Autoselling Artifacts

We’ve added a new feature to the Forge called Artifact Quick Craft. It allows you to simultaneously craft multiple Artifacts of one specific Set. To use the Quick Craft feature, you must have at least 1 slot free in either your Artifact Storage or Inbox.

You can customize how you use Quick Craft by setting the desired number of Artifacts you'd like to craft, and manage other settings to automatically sell Artifacts you don’t want to keep.

Artifacts obtained via Quick Craft (including any that are automatically sold) are counted towards any related Events, Tournaments, Missions, CvC or other in-game activities.

Read more about Artifact Quick Craft in the Guide: Forge.

Siege - Draw condition improvement

We are constantly looking to improve Siege, and this time around, we’ve tackled the draw conditions. Now, if both Clans destroy each other’s Strongholds and also receive the same number of Victory Medals, then the Clan that protected the most Team slots in their own buildings will be declared the winner.

Gear Ascension Tournament

We’re also introducing a new type of Tournament, called Gear Ascension Tournament. You’ll need to get as many Oils and Extracts as you can to earn Points, and pick up some great rewards!

Chimera Clan Quest rebalance

Some of the Chimera Clan Quests we created turned out to be tougher than we thought. With that in mind, we’ve rebalanced some of them to make them a little easier - they’re still a challenge though!

Market Refresh button repositioning

Background Battles Are Available For Everyone 
Good news! Two days ago, we finally opened Background Battles to all players. Thank you for your patience while we were gradually opening this feature to a bigger audience.

 Selling gear is impossible directly from the Background Multi-Battle window: it is not a bug but a peculiarity of this feature.  The Power Of The [Deathbrand] Can Be Resisted. As you know, Champions under a [Deathbrand] receive the [Block Revive] debuff when killed. As Teleria marks its 6th Anniversary and your Champions revel in the festivities, we invite you to unwind with the first spring RAID Digest. Grab your favorite beverage, settle in, and see what's new in the realm!

You might wonder where the promised Background Multi-Battles are, which should have been implemented into the game in the latest update. Worry not! Background Multi-Battles are being gradually rolled out to all players, so it may take a couple more weeks until you receive access to them. We would like to emphasize that this is only one of the first steps towards time-saving optimizations. We're only getting started with this feature. Live Arena Seasons

That’s not all - we’ve also added Avatar Frames that you can obtain from Chests by finishing in 1st, 2nd-10th, and 11th-100th in Live Arena Seasonal Leagues.

notes.title: RAID Digest (07.02.25)
notes.content:
Greetings, Raiders!

After the fierce Siege battles and an eventful 10.20 release, we believe it’s time to sit back and enjoy our Friday RAID Digest. Without further ado - let’s start!

Hydra Quick Battles

We introduced Hydra Quick Battles in the last release and want to address some common questions. Our goal with Hydra was to encourage team optimization and synergy.

To preserve player interaction, manual or semi-auto battles remain the best strategy for top results. Quick Battles are a time-saving tool for those willing to trade some efficiency for convenience. We recommend fine-tuning your teams first before testing them in Quick Battles.

Another point we would like to highlight regarding Quick battles is their duration. Unlike Demon Lord Quick Battles, the Hydra ones take a little longer (up to several minutes), as it takes time to model all those 1000 turns. 

Aspect of Siroth Relic and Its Effect on the Turn Meter Manipulation
In update 10.20, we introduced an Immunity skills fix. Now, when a Champion’s skill states they are “Immune” to certain debuffs or effects, they are truly immune to them.

There is one exception to the rule, though. Turn meter manipulation immunity protects Champions only from effects generated by the enemy. So effects from Relics such as Aspect of Siroth will still apply to the "immune" Champions. We will adjust the skill description to better reflect this caveat

Champion Rebalance Process  

After each Champions rebalance, we often see the same questions, so we decided to clarify some of the aspects players were curious about.

Q: How do devs choose Champions to rebalance?

 Player feedback and in-game Champion ratings (now that it has been reset) are essential factors. Players know best the strong and weak sides of the Champion, so we prioritize Champions that players see as lacking and make appropriate changes. 
 History of rebalances. If the Champion already had a rebalance recently, they are less likely to receive another one.
 Older Champions have a higher priority than the new ones. However, it is a case-by-case process, so you can still see newer champions in our monthly rebalances.
 Void affinity also affects our decision. Void Legendaries are hard to come by, so we want them to meet player expectations and update their kits when possible.
 Champions from persistent Fusions or similar sources have a lesser priority for rebalance. They are mainly meant to introduce mechanics to players or fulfill somewhat niche roles on the team, so are less likely to receive a rebalance, as long as they serve that purpose.

Q: Why do we not rebalance Champions more often?

Rebalance of a Champion is essentially the same process as creating a new one, with the added bonus that the Champion model is already in the game. While it may not look like it on the outside, it is a long process that involves work from multiple departments, and if we prioritize rebalancing more champions, it will significantly slow down our update release schedule. 

Rebalances are an endless process, so when we have any wiggle room in the update, we are more likely to include QoL features than an additional Champion rebalance.

Q: What do we take into account when choosing which Skills to rebalance?

Champion's intended role and function. Performance in that role is what we look into the most, so we boost stats and abilities that will make them better at the role. There are, of course, cases where Champion rework completely changes the skills or event roles of the Champions, but they are an exception, not the rule.

Clan vs. Clan Tournament and Personal Rewards

Prepare your weapons and polish the armor, as the next installment of the Clan Tournament will come with personal rewards. May the strongest Clan hold the victory!

That’s all we have for today, take care, and we’ll see you in two weeks' time.

notes.title: New Update: Version 10.20.0
notes.content:
Update 10.20.0 is here! Check out Hydra Quick Battle, Campaign Super Raids, as well as various rebalances, improvements and fixes.

Hydra Quick Battle

We are adding the highly-requested Quick Battle feature to the Hydra Clan Boss. This will be an option for players who want to fight the Hydra, but do not want to watch the whole battle play out in real-time. Quick Battle will be available for every Hydra difficulty, but must first be unlocked by dealing a set amount of damage using a single Hydra Key. 

The amount of damage needed to unlock Quick Battle corresponds to the amount of damage needed to receive the highest value Hydra Chest on that particular difficulty.

It is possible to unlock Quick Battle for several Hydra difficulties at once. For example, if a player achieves the Quick Battle unlock conditions on Brutal, it will also unlock Quick Battle on all Hydra difficulties below Brutal.

Team presets and general Hydra battle mechanics remain the same as if the player was running the battle normally in Auto mode. Once a player has initiated a Quick Battle, they cannot interfere with the battle until it finishes. 

Players can use Quick Battle a limited number of times during one weekly cycle. After the cycle is over, the number of Quick Battles resets automatically. It is possible to discard a Quick Battle result without spending a Hydra Key.

Campaign Super-Raids

The good old Super Raids are now available in the Campaign. Save time, raid the Campaign, and get double the rewards!

Fragments Exchange Lock

We’ve added a lock on the Champion Fragments Exchange feature to ensure that you can’t accidentally exchange a complete set of Champion Fragments you want to hold onto.

New Clan Levels + Clan Shop Items

As part of this update, we’re also adding 5 more Clan levels, which all come with the extra Silver for completing Campaign Stages, additional Multi-Battles, and two more slots in the Clan Shop. There are also new resources available in the Clan Shop – Rank 1-3 Basalt, Gilded Medallions, and a Gemstone Box!

QoL: Champion names in the Soul Collection

We’ve added Champion names and Faction icons to the Soul Collection window in the Altar of Souls and a few other places, so you won’t get confused about which Champion Souls you have.

QoL: Chaos Dust and Chaos Powder amount depiction

We’ve also added a visual depiction of your total Chaos Dust and Chaos Powder on the victory screens when you tap the resource icon, so it’s easier to keep track of your resources.

QoL: Total Stats Window

We changed the order of tabs in the Total Stats window in the Champion Collection, so now you can immediately see the stats of your Champion instead of having to switch a tab first.

Stage Requirement Filter

Now, when you tap on the Champions button in the Team Selection screen when taking on Doom Tower Secret Rooms and Faction Wars, you’ll be taken to the Champions window with filters already active.

Filter out Faction Guardians

We have added a new option for the Champion Filter in the Tavern and Empower Champions tab of the Guardian Ring, enabling you to hide Champions that are set as Faction Guardians.

AI Fixes

We have addressed AI bugs across a wide variety of locations in the game. Check out the full list of skills, Champions, and Bosses that have been affected in the news post titled A Smoother Game Awaits: AI Bugs Fixed.

Immunity Skills fix

Another change we’ve implemented is to make sure that when a Champion’s skill states that they are “Immune” to certain debuffs or effects, that they are truly immune to those things. If another skill states that it will place a guaranteed debuff, ignore a portion of the target’s RES, or ignore [Block Debuffs] buffs, it will still not bypass “Immunity”.  He-Man

Campaign Boss XP Rebalance

We’ve rebalanced the amount of XP earned from Campaign Bosses when facing them on Normal, Hard, and Brutal difficulties, ensuring it’s more consistent. Now each Campaign Boss grants gradually more XP than the previous one.

New Relics

We’ve also added a new batch of Relics, called the Clan Group. Discover 8 new Relics, which can be crafted from a new resource, Gilded Medallions, which themselves can be obtained in the Clan Shop.

notes.title: RAID Digest (10.01.25)
notes.content:
Queen of Hearts has brought havoc into the realms of Teleria and entrenched herself in the Event Dungeon, though judging by the grim resolve of Alice (and her menacing enormous sword) that bizarre regime won't last uncontested for long. Well, heads will roll, that's for sure. 

By the way, if you are really into the vibe of Alice's Adventure in RAID, it becomes even "curiouser" down the road - keep an eye out for news about community activities on our official social media next week. Meanwhile, you may start designing a new Wonderland-themed Clan Insignia, wink-wink.

So, without further ado, welcome to the first RAID Digest of the year 2025!

Alice's Adventures - Availability of Special Champions and Relics

All of the Champions added via the Alice's Adventure will be permanently added to RAID's Champion pool. The Mad Hatter, the Knave of Hearts, and the Cheshire Cat are obtainable via Shards from January 8th, the Queen of Hearts will be available for summoning from Void Shards starting March 5th, and Alice the Wanderer will be available from Shards from March 27th.

However, keep an eye on our official news: there might be special in-game Events and Tournaments to help you get the Cheshire Cat, the Queen of Hearts, and the Knave of Hearts.

If you are interested in crafting Alice's Adventure-themed Relics (Cat's Gaze, Hatter's Reserve), watch out for special crafting materials for them (Regal Masques) among rewards in Events and Tournaments during the Alice's Adventure campaign, as it might be the exceptional opportunity to get your hands on these unique resources.

Bug Fixes and other Clarifications

Now, let’s turn our attention to less surreal matters


 We've noticed that after the update 10.10, certain Champions stopped prioritizing attacking Heads that are digesting their teammates or Exposed necks in auto-battle mode. We'll fix these AI behavior deviations in future updates.
 Defeating Queen of Hearts in the Event Dungeon on higher stages grants you not only Legendary but potentially Mythical Artifacts and Accessories as well, contrary to the in-game description, which states Legendary items are the highest possible rarity. We'll correct that description in the future;
 Some Chimera Trials specify more than one slot with rewards for their completion. Please note that these “Possible drops” slots list all the possible reward options, whereas the player may receive only one item per completed Trial;
 During the Chimera reset from Thursday 11.30 UTC to Friday 11.30 UTC the timer on the difficulty selection screen ("Time remaining:…") indicates the remaining time countdown after which you will be able to fight Chimera again, not the remaining time to use your keys, as it is not possible to use them during the timeframe specified above;


Clan vs. Clan Tournament and Personal Rewards

The upcoming installment of CvC Tournament will feature Personal Rewards. Following the holiday season without such a tournament, many Clans prepared well for the fierce competition to come, so get ready.

That's all for today. Take care, and see you in another RAID Digest in two weeks!

notes.title: New Update: Version 10.10.0
notes.content:
Update 10.10.0 is here! Check out the new Market rework, as well as various rebalances, improvements and fixes.

Market Rework

With Update 10.10, we’ve aggregated all the various in-game Shops into the Market, which can be found in the Bastion. From there, you’ll now be able to access the Clan Shop, Token Trader, Bazaar, Mystic Market, and Soul Merchant. On top of that, we’re adding 6* Artifacts, as well as Artifacts from Dungeons to the Market. We’ve also rebalanced the rate at which Artifact Rarity is calculated, so higher-Level players will find higher Rarity Artifacts in the Market.

Team Setup Visual Improvement

We’ve also made a visual improvement in the Team Performance and the Teams of the Week windows. Now, the Artifact sets equipped on Champions do not overlap.

Doom Tower Waves Rebalance - Rotations 2 & 3

Due to Skull Lord Var-Gall’s rebalance, we’ve made changes to the Doom Tower stages that feature more than one Skull Lord Var-Gall on the team, both in Normal and Hard modes. One Skull Lord Var-Gall has been replaced with a different Champion from the Lizardmen Faction.

Champions Rating Reset

All Champions will have their Ratings in the Champions window reset. You will be able to rate Champions again based on new content added to Raid since those Champions were initially released. If you find yourself unable to rate Champions following the update, you may need to wait a day.

Added Berserk to Boss Immunities

All Bosses are now also immune to the [Berserk] debuff.

PvP Blessings & Masteries in Siege

The Lethal Dose and Incinerate Blessings now work in Siege battles. The Kill Streak Mastery now also increases damage inflicted by 6% for each enemy killed in Siege battles.

New version: Attacks all enemies. Has a 50% chance of placing a 30% [Decrease SPD] debuff for 2 turns. Also has a 30% chance of placing a [Fear] debuff for 1 turn on enemies with 50% or less Turn Meter.

[Skill 2 – Stagnation Sickness]

- Effect added: After attacking, has an 80% chance of decreasing each enemy's Turn Meter by 30%.

[Skill 3 – Beyond Emotions]

- Effect added: Places a [Block Debuffs] buff on all allies for 2 turns.

[Skill 4 – Uncanny ]

- Effect added: Now also immune to [Stun], [Freeze], [Fear] and [True Fear] debuffs.

Skull Lord Var-Gall

- Skill changed

Old version: Attacks 1 enemy 2 times. Each hit fills this Champion's Turn Meter by 5%. Has a 30% chance to repeat this skill. Places a 100% [Heal Reduction] debuff on the target for 2 turns if this skill is repeated.

New version: Attacks 1 enemy 2 times. Each hit fills this Champion's Turn Meter by 5%. Has a 30% chance to repeat this skill. Each hit places a 100% [Heal Reduction] debuff on the target for 2 turns. This debuff cannot be resisted if there is at least 1 ally Champion from the Lizardmen Faction on your team.

notes.title: RAID Digest (27.12.24)
notes.content:
Hello, Raiders!

This was quite an eventful year in Teleria: 

 We raided some Monster Hunter vaults, and definitely Teleria-based, not named “Rathalos Set” artifacts are now featured in Forge passes. 
 Armanz started his domination on the open pastures of Live Arena. 
 Players decided on what Wixwell would bring to the table, and while some were skeptical, he brought with him the whole table and started making barricades right in front of Hydra. For a while, the four-headed snake even seemed subdued, but then the next thing we knew, the serpent adapted to the challenge and became a much more vicious foe. 
 Ninja has returned into the game to lend his help to the new wave of Raiders. 
 Clans have entered a new stage of the conflict, and started full-blown Siege of each other's fortresses. By the way, here is an updated infographic.  https://plrm.info/Clan_Fortress_Bonuses
 Gods of Asgard made their own insurgency into Teleria. While Odin Faefather had opened the challenge to all champions in the Event dungeon, Loki sneakily, (if we call mopping the floor with Arbiter and her chosen ones “sneaky”), opened a whole other mysterious looking door. 
 Entirely unrelated to the said door, the Chimera was let loose on Teleria, opening a new challenge for the clans, and an opportunity to get stronger by the power of mysterious Relics. 
 To make matters worse, Skeletor took our Death Knight under his wing and started filling his head with dastardly plans and cunning schemes. He was extremely unsuccessful, but still.

There was much more that happened this year, and we wanted to say Thank you to our dear RAID community, for staying with us through these years, for being passionate about this game we make, and we hope to keep you entertained for years to come!

This is the last Digest of the year, yet we do have some more mundane things that we want to mention:

Clan vs Clan Tournament

The next Tournament will start on January 14, 2025. So you can ignore your clan leader for the next week or so.

Compensation

Relics are a new feature, regrettably, some came with unexpected bugs that affected the Chimera Clash. So, in the name of fairness, we will send one Rare and one Epic gemstone, the equivalent of the last two Chimera Clash milestone chests, to the players who were not using the exploits created by the bugs. Thank you for your patience and restraint, Raiders.
We do not have the date for when the compensation will be sent just yet. We will provide you with more information a bit later.

That is all we have for today.
Happy New Year, and stay safe!

notes.title: RAID Digest (13.12.24)
notes.content:
Greetings, Raiders! 

As many of you are busy working out your best strategies against the Chimera, it will be the primary subject of today's RAID Digest. So, without further ado, let's get started.

Clarifications about Chimera's Reset Time Frame

Chimera reset day begins at 11:30 UTC on Thursday and ends at 11:30 UTC on Friday. During this period, players cannot participate in Chimera battles and earn Clash points. If a battle ends after 11:30 UTC on Thursday, the player will receive rewards for Trials they completed during it, but otherwise, the damage dealt during such a battle won't count towards Chimera Chests or Chimera Clash. After 7:00 UTC on Friday, players can claim the Chimera Clash Chest. After 11:30 UTC on Friday, players can claim the Chimera Chests and start the next Chimera Clash.

As for the time frame to change the Clan, if a player leaves the Clan before 7:00 UTC on Friday, they cannot claim the Chimera Clash Chest. If a player leaves the Clan after 7:00 UTC on Friday, they will still receive the Chimera Clash Chest but will not receive the Chimera Chest for damage dealt. If a player joins a new clan immediately after receiving the Chimera Clash Chest (and forfeiting the Chimera Chest for damage dealt), they will be able to participate in the Chimera Clash in their new Clan. However, if a player waits to claim both the Chimera Clash Chest and the Chimera Chest for damage dealt and then switches clans afterward, they will not be able to participate in the Chimera Clash in their new Clan.

Comments on Chimera Battle Mechanics and Known Bugs


 Relic Diadem of Death currently has effects it shouldn’t have, including increasing damage for skills that scale based on enemy MAX HP more than it should, causing Champions to land debuffs on bosses that otherwise are immune to them, etc. Some other Relics (Tempus Sanguinis among them) seem to also indicate similar bugs in the way they function. We’re working on the fix to deliver it as soon as possible.
 Ram Trials - currently, if a Champion delivers an attack on the boss but dies from the reflected damage, the damage of that attack doesn't count towards the Ram Trial that requires damaging the Chimera within 3 turns while it is under a [Decrease DEF] debuff and players' Champions are under [Perfect Veil] buffs, which is a bug to be fixed in the next major update.
 Lion Trials - the description of the Trial "Damage the Chimera while it is under 1 or more debuffs and your Champions are under [Increase DEF] buffs" is incorrect and will be rectified. To complete the Trial, the player has to deliver the specified amount of damage to the Chimera in a single hit while the beast is under 5 or more debuffs.
 Damage Cap in the Passive skill [Almighty Chimera] - as you may know, the damage from skills that scale based on the enemy's MAX HP cannot exceed a certain amount (100k on Easy, 120k on Normal, etc.). However, you may notice damage numbers that do exceed the supposed cap. That happens because the restriction applies to the initial amount of damage before all the contributing factors get calculated, like critical DMG, buffs, debuffs, passives, etc.
 Another description error we've recently noticed is the additional effect of Ramantu's A2, which might be especially important for particular Chimera Trials. The skill lands [True Fear] debuffs on all the enemies that have 4 or more debuffs, excluding the initial target of the skill. The skill has been working that way all along, as it is supposed to do, but the nuance about the initial target has been missing from the skill description, so we will fix that.
 Please note that when the Chimera changes forms during the battle, it loses all debuffs, even those protected from the usual cleanse (have the yellow border around them), because otherwise, completing trials would be considerably messier.
 While we're on the topic of shapeshifting, it has been found that Mythical Sylvan Watcher Nell Blackteeth curiously doesn't metamorph during battles due to an ancient curse known as a code bug that we are going to dispel in the next major update.


Clan vs Clan Tournament and Personal Rewards

The 95th installment of CvC Tournament starts on December 17 and will feature Personal Rewards. By the way, it will be the last CvC Tournament this year, with the next one planned on January 14, 2025. 

That's all for today's RAID Digest! Have a great weekend, and happy holidays!

notes.title: New Update: Version 10.00.0
notes.content:
Update 10.00.0 is a big one! We’re introducing Relics, a transforming Clan Boss called the Chimera, Champion rebalances, and more. Keep your eyes peeled as tomorrow, you’ll find out more about this new Clan Boss when it is released to the world.

Relics

Relics are a new type of Champion Equipment, different from other Gear such as Artifacts and Accessories. Relics are located in a different tab of your Champion Collection.

Only one Relic can be equipped to a Champion at a time and it provides stat boosts, as well as a unique Ability to the wearer. All Relics are unique and have fixed stats.

Relics can be crafted on the new tab in the Forge using Ocular Masses, received by fighting the Chimera.

A Relic’s Level can be upgraded by spending a new resource, Starstones. A Relic’s Rank can also be increased by sacrificing other Relics or using another new resource, Basalt. By upgrading a Relic’s' Level and Rank, its stats are increased, new substats are unlocked, and its Ability improves.

Relics have 1-4 Sockets, depending on their Rarity, which can be filled with Gemstones that provide additional passive Abilities. Starstones, Basalt, and Gemstones will all be obtainable from defeating the Chimera.

Champion rebalance

Gamuran

- Effect changed: Now each hit has a 30% chance of placing a Block Active Skills debuff for 2 turns.

New version: Revives 1 random ally with 30% HP and 30% Turn Meter each time an enemy is killed. Revives 1 random ally with 30% HP and 30% Turn Meter each time a Block Revive debuff is placed on an enemy.

Opardin Clanfather

- Effect changed: Now each hit has a 50% chance of decreasing the target's Turn Meter by 10% and a 50% chance of filling this Champion's Turn Meter by 10%.

notes.title: RAID Digest (29.11.24)
notes.content:
Hello, Raiders!

So many exciting things have happened in RAID since the last time we talked! Now, before we all travel to the Stormwind Wastes to try and defeat the almighty Chimera, there are some things we’d like to talk to you about. Without further ado, let’s get started.

Some Clarifications about the He-Man and Skeletor Campaign

There have been many questions regarding the ways of getting He-Man. Currently, this Champion is only obtainable through the Champion Pass; however, we also intend to make him summonable from Shards for the dedicated Summon Boost Events while the Champion Pass is still active. 

He-Man & Skeletor in-game music theme

Apart from their cool looks, these two Champions have something else to surprise you with. Check them out in the Index section, and do not forget to turn your game volume up - we’ve got a special tune for you to enjoy. 

He-Man and "I Have The Power!" Skill

There seems to be some confusion within the community regarding the way He-Man’s "I Have The Power!" skill works, so let us clarify that. The skill counts each buff that is being placed on He-Man, before using this skill. Also, replacing an existing buff with the same buffs but with longer durations will add a stack. Finally, the stack counter isn’t affected when the buff is removed, replaced, or expires.

Dungeons Randomly Switch to Normal Mode

Dungeons occasionally switch from Hard to Normal mode, which is not okay. This bug will be fixed in one of the next big releases. Pay attention to the mode you enter every time you hit Dungeons in order not to waste Energy and time.

Clan Tournament and Personal Rewards

Brace yourself, Raiders, as the new installment of the Clan Tournament is coming to Teleria. This one will be without personal rewards, but prepare for the fearsome battle nevertheless. And may the mightiest opponent take the victory! 

That’s all we have for you today. Have a marvelous weekend, and we'll see you in two weeks!

notes.title: RAID Digest (15.11.24)
notes.content:
Hello, Raiders! While we are in full preparation for something wicked that stirs in the Stormwind, we want to address some of the more present concerns. Mainly Hydra.

Hydra

Let's start with the good news right away: change to the “Serpent's Will” buff spawn. We had a lot of feedback regarding the new version of the “Serpent's Will” buff, especially turns where all 4 heads have protection, and Champions cannot deal any damage to them. As a solution, we came up with a pretty simple rule that should address this issue directly: There will be no more than 3 “Serpent's will” buffs that can be active at the same time. So the turns where no target can be damaged will become impossible. While we don't have a specific date yet, this change should be in the game with the next big update.

We are also working on some additional changes to, simply put, make some of the mechanics more effective against Hydra, while also reducing tedious parts of the battle. However, we are still testing them and cannot provide any more information until we are sure that they will have a positive impact on players' teams and their performances.

We want to apologize for the slow updates regarding the Hydra. Changes to the Hydra mode itself were announced a long time ago, and it took us a long time to test and implement everything. Sadly, even after all that time, we still have some rough edges and bugs. We understand your frustration and will do our best to make appropriate changes faster and be as open and clear about what we are going to do as possible.

On Questions about Mythical Champions

notes.title: New Update: Version 9.40.0
notes.content:
With Update 9.40.0, we’re adding a new Plarium Play Card, introducing some Live Arena and Siege tweaks, an expansion of the Clan Shop, and additional Clan Levels. We’re also rebalancing two Champions and making some changes to the Demon Lord reset timing. See the full breakdown below.

New card in the Plarium Points Program

We’ve added a new card to the Plarium Points Program - the Warm-up Card. This new Card has been designed to offer rewards that are easy to obtain and will help prepare players for everything else in-game. The rewards in this Card include an Epic Dwarf Champion, Morag Bronzelock, and other useful items. 

Live Arena Improvements

We have added a new Live Arena Quest, “Live Arena Daily Wins”, which will reward players when they win 1, 3, and 5 Battles. There is also a new Advanced Quest, “Win 1 Live Arena Battle”, that will replace current Arena Quests for players who are level 60 and above. Matchmaking for newer players has also been adjusted to make starting this PvP mode smoother.

The Live Arena schedule has also been expanded:

 00:00 - 03:00 UTC
 06:00 - 09:00 UTC
 13:00 - 16:00 UTC
 19:00 - 22:00 UTC

Expanded conditions for receiving Siege rewards

Now, if a Clan destroys a Stronghold or a Mana Shrine, or if a Clan’s Stronghold or Mana Shrines remain intact at the end of the Battle Phase, all Clan Members who have set at least 1 Defense Team, won at least 1 ATK battle, or captured at least 1 enemy Team Slot during the current Siege will receive a Mana Orb reward. If a Clan has won a Siege, then each Clan Member who has set at least 1 Defense Team, won at least 1 ATK battle, or captured at least 1 enemy Team Slot during the current Siege will receive a Victory Chest. The same conditions apply to receiving Milestone Rewards, as well as Florins for defending a Team Slot, defeating an enemy team, or capturing an empty enemy Team Slot.

Reduced cost of repairing Buildings in Siege

We have drastically reduced the cost of repairing the Stronghold, Magic Towers, Defense Towers, and Mana Shrines.

Adjusted Siege ATK Scrolls distribution system

Here is how the Siege ATK Scrolls distribution system will work now: at the start of the Battle Phase, ATK Scrolls are evenly distributed between all Clan Members. If the total number of ATK Scrolls (which is equal to the total number of enemy Team Slots) cannot be divided equally between Clan Members, the remaining ATK Scrolls are given to Clan Members according to their Clan Role’s priority (Clan Leader being the highest priority, followed by Deputies, Lieutenants, and Soldiers being the lowest priority). If there are several Clan Members with the same Role, the ones with higher Team Power will have a higher priority. There are also a total of 5 additional ATK Scrolls given to the Clan and distributed by the same logic.

Siege Victory Medals rebalance

We have changed the number of Victory Medals given to Clans for protecting and destroying the Stronghold and Mana Shrines. Defending the Stronghold and a Mana Shrine will now bring your Clan 1200 and 450 Medals respectively. Destroying an enemy Stronghold and a Mana Shrine will now bring you 1300 and 550 Medals respectively.

New Clan Levels and Clan Shop Expansion

As part of this update, we’re also adding 5 more Clan levels, which all come with the extra Silver for completing Campaign Stages, additional Multi-Battles, and two more slots in the Clan Shop. There are also new resources available in the Clan Shop - Chaos Dust, Chaos Powder, and Artifact Chests that may contain Mythical Rank 6 Killstroke Artifacts!

The Demon Lord reset changes

In order to optimize server traffic, we’ve changed the daily reset time for the Demon Lord to between 10:00 UTC and 11:00 UTC. We’ve also added a new restriction for players moving Clans - you will not be able to fight the Demon Lord for one hour after joining a new Clan.

notes.title: RAID Digest (01.11.24)
notes.content:
Teleria is still immersed in an eerie atmosphere: the Halloween spirit can be felt throughout the endless expanses of its realm and far beyond its borders. Do not forget to turn on the sound when playing RAID to hear the new music theme we created specifically for Halloween.  

While Deathknight keeps peeping out of his cozy coffin (who is he waving at?), we’re inviting you all to dive into our next #RAIDDigest. 

Hydra 

We remain consistent in preserving the concept that Hydra should be able to take turns to perform an attempt to either kill or devour Champions, as we perceive this as a fundamental principle of Hydra mode.
Exposed neck’s limited HP, increasingly higher additional devour HP and stronger Serpent’s Will are designed to allow Hydra to continue acting according to that principle, to take turns and to be increasingly able to devour player’s Champions. That being said, we agree that facing all four heads at once with the Serpent Will buff is annoying and just feels too harsh because you can’t deal any damage. We appreciate your suggested solutions in this regard, and our GDs are already thinking about ways to mitigate that.

Also, with the nearest release, we’ll implement a few improvements to Champion AI in Hydra Battles. Next week, we’ll reveal the details in our Update Highlights and Release Notes. 

While we're on the topic of Hydra, let us share some internal info: according to the analytical data, the diversity of the teams that took top places over the past two Hydra Clashes has increased. We hope to leave the days when one player could defeat the entire clan behind us. 

Bug Fixes And Improvements 


 The Famous Red Dot that appears on the Battle button and the Siege tab is living its last days (at least that’s what we hope). The fix is planned for the nearest release.
 In addition, we will fix an issue with the Chat, when a player is redirected to the Global chat while typing a message in the Clan chat.
 Last but not least, Siege will see several QoL changes, including reducing the cost of repairing the buildings. More details will be available next week!


Gretel & Hansel: a Special Gift 

If you manage to get both of these Champions - Gretel Hagbane and Hansel Witchhunter, you’ll get a special gift - a Legendary Skill Tome, a Rank 5 Chicken, 4 x 50 multi-battle attempts, 1,000 Energy, and 1M Silver. To get the bonus goodies, you’ll need to have both Champions by November 24. We’ll inform you later about the exact date/time when we will start sending the gift.

Fragments of the Brewguard Jeroboam and Freyja 

With the upcoming update, you will get the possibility of exchanging unused Brewguard Jeroboam’s and Freyja Fateweaver’s fragments for Exchange Chests.

CvC Tournament and Personal Rewards

Here's a traditional and final part of the Digest: the next CvC Tournament will be without Personal Rewards.

That's it for today's Digest. 
Have a great weekend!

notes.title: New Update: Version 9.30.0
notes.content:
With Update 9.30.0, we’re introducing Avatar Frames, Rotating Champions in the Token Trader, and new Badges. We are also rebalancing two Champions and adding more conditions to achieve victory in Siege. Check out the full breakdown below.

Avatar Frames

We’re adding Frames to decorate your in-game Avatars. You can get them from various game modes, such as Cursed City, Arena, and Hydra Clash, as well as Events, Tournaments, and more.

New Badges

We have added 27 new Badges so that you can show off more of your achievements – Mastery Veteran, Feller of Demons, and Serpent Slayer to name a few.

New Siege Victory conditions

On October 7, we will add more conditions to achieve victory in Siege. Here’s how it will work after the changes take effect: if both Clans destroy each other's Strongholds and also receive the same number of Victory Medals, then the Clan who has won more attack and defense battles will be declared the winner. Capturing empty enemy Team Slots counts too. Mana Shrine rebattles do not count.

If the number of defeated enemy teams is the same for both Clans, then the Clan who has used less turns in battles will be declared the winner. The turns are counted only in those battles where the Clan has achieved victory. Enemy turns are not counted. Mana Shrine rebattles do not count, neither does capturing empty enemy Team Slots.

Rotating Champions within the Token Trader

We’re introducing Rotating Champions within the Token Trader. These Champions are time-limited with a new Champion rotating in when the current timer expires. Rotating Champions can be obtained multiple times from the Token Trader, should they appear in the rotation after being previously purchased.

Supreme Club

In this update, we are excited to introduce the Supreme Club – a new initiative aimed at fostering a unique community and enhancing players’ gaming experience through exclusive services. This initial launch is a limited test, with invitations going out to select members of our player base. We’re eager to expand the Club, offering more players the opportunity to join as we refine and enhance the offerings based on your feedback and our ongoing development plans.

notes.title: Raid Digest (06.09.24)
notes.content:
Once again, as many times before, we have a new RAID Digest to inform you of some future plans, fun bugs, and The Prophecy. So without further ado, let's jump into it.

Siege update

We usually refrain from updates without a finalized date, yet we know that everyone is passionate about the Siege game mode, and we want to keep you in the loop as much as possible.

At the moment, we are working on:

 Battle Scrolls system - the current system highly favors the attacker, especially considering the early stages of the Stronghold’s expansion. So, we are working on a solution that will reduce the amount of battle scrolls in play while the attackers still have ways to correct or bolster their attack. Multiple solutions are being tested, and we will publish the full breakdown once it is finalized.
 Regarding players who missed the Siege because their clan was too quick/efficient in their victory - we are changing the requirements for participation, and now it will be “won at least one battle OR place one team in Clan Defense” So, everyone in the clan will receive rewards as long as they participate in defense, if their clan will be victorious, of course.
 We are looking into new tools for the clan Leaders to coordinate the attack on enemy defense positions. We are currently working on the flag system so that during the Siege battle phase, the clan sees what fights/locations they should prioritize and what defenders they should avoid.

All of these changes and more are currently in different stages of development and will likely be released separately. We will do our best to keep you updated.

Event dungeon

The event dungeon has a secret, and it is known to everyone who tried to slow down the role of the Faefather in his temporary abode… Similarly to the Dragon's Lair, bosses in the Event dungeon are immune to the turn meter manipulation. Regrettably, this fact is not reflected in the boss's description due to it being a location-specific modifier. We are looking into ways to add this info to the Location and make it evident without any additional actions on the player's part.

Wight King Narses is trying to conceal his actions in the Event dungeon by skipping some of his animations. While we respect the hustle, it is still a bug that can cause issues or even create critical errors in the game, and we are working on a fix.

At the moment, there is a mistake in the Event dungeon drop description. Artifacts and accessories of the Mythical rarity can be obtained on the highest levels of the Event Dungeons. The description will be corrected in one of the future releases.

Thor Faehammer

 At the moment, his passive stacks with blessings and masteries when he fights bosses. It is a bug, and it will be fixed shortly.

 You receive additional ATK scrolls even if the enemy Clan had upgraded their fortress but stepped into the Battle phase with all the buildings destroyed, which means they cannot fill more than 60 DEF positions and are put at a disadvantage;

notes.title: New Update: Version 9.10.0
notes.content:
With Update 9.10.0, we’re introducing Milestone Rewards into the Hydra Clash, as well as adding Siege tasks to the Clan League interface, rebalancing Champions, and more. You may even notice a new structure in the Dungeon Map - keep your eyes peeled, we’ll be announcing more on this soon! See the full breakdown below.

Milestone Rewards in Hydra Clash

We’re introducing Milestone Rewards into the Hydra Clash, meaning you can earn Chests with powerful Accessories as you earn personal Clash Points. Personal Clash Points are accumulated, and are not reset at the end of each weekly Hydra cycle, monthly Hydra rotation, or at the end of each Hydra Clash.

If you claim all the Milestone Rewards, your personal Clash Points will be reset in the next weekly cycle, and you’ll be able to start earning Milestone Rewards again from scratch. If you continue earning Clash Points during the current weekly cycle after having reached the last Milestone Reward, your Clash Points will still reset during the new weekly cycle.

If you reach the final Milestone Reward but don’t claim some of the rewards along the way, your personal Clash Points will still reset in the next weekly cycle and any unclaimed rewards will be sent to your Inbox. If you leave your Clan with unclaimed Milestone Rewards, they will be sent to your Inbox. Your Milestone Rewards progress will also be saved, meaning you can pick up from where you left off when you join a new Clan.

New Clan League tasks

We have added Siege-related tasks to the Clan League interface. These tasks are focused around winning a Siege, and the number of Points that can be earned will depend on your Clan’s current Siege Tier.

We are also adding a new Clan League - Platinum - with 5 Clan Stars to earn.

Game Start Changes

When starting the game as a new player, a red dot indicator will now only appear in the Fragment Summon tab of the Portal for Champions that can be earned via Events, or when receiving Champion Fragments.

The Instant Upgrade feature will now unlock at Level 5, not Level 40.

Players can now automatically upgrade their Gear to Levels 12 and 16 at Levels 10 and 20 respectively.

If the target ally is not fully healed, places a [Block Damage] buff on them for 2 turns. If the ally is fully healed, fills their Turn Meter by 50% and heals all allies equal to 50% of the surplus heal.

[Skill 3 – Rhythmic Strength]

Nobel

[Skill 1 – Smell Fear]

Old version: Attacks 1 enemy. Has a 40% chance of decreasing the duration of 2 random buffs on the target by 1 turn. If the target is under a [Fear] or [True Fear] debuff, has a 65% chance of decreasing the duration of all of the target's buffs by 1 turn instead.

New version: Attacks 1 enemy. Has a 40% chance of decreasing the duration of 2 random buffs on the target by 1 turn.

If the target is under a [Fear] or [True Fear] debuff, decreases the duration of all of the target's buffs by 1 turn instead.

notes.title: RAID Digest 26.07.24
notes.content:
Hello Raiders! 

Our very first Siege swept over Teleria: the Battle Phase is over, and it is time to take a step back and look around: analyze how your Clan fared in the first Siege,  think about new strategies, and start preparing your Clan Fortress for the new round. 

Siege is our newest feature; while some of the balancing may seem a bit off-mark at the moment, we are dedicated to making this game mode as fun and rewarding as possible. That’s why we will closely monitor everything that happens on Siege during the next few launches, analyzing internal data and all the Siege-related feedback shared by the Community and making appropriate adjustments along the way.

We encourage you to keep posting further feedback on Siege—it helps us find ways to improve the feature. Thank you for your effort.

Without further ado, let’s delve into the SIEGE Digest!

Matchmaking.

During the first launch of the Siege, all Clans were divided into Tiers in accordance with their Tiers in the last 4 CvC Tournaments. Additionally, clans were sorted by the time of creation to make the in-game experience a bit more balanced. As you know, it wasn't perfect, but this distribution was relevant only for the first launch. Starting from the next Siege, the game will match Clans depending on the number of Victory Points they earned from the current Siege, which will gradually improve matchmaking during the next few Sieges. 

Siege Points. 

There are 2 types of points in Siege: Victory Medals and Victory Points. 

Victory Medals are needed to declare the winner in Siege and to get Milestone rewards. 

Clans earn Victory Medals by destroying opponents’ Buildings and keeping their own Buildings standing  - at least one defense team needs to remain standing within a building to prevent it from being captured.
Each building has its weight in Victory Medals. 

Stronghold - 1250 Victory Medals;
Mana Shrine - 500 VM;
Magic Tower - 250 VM;
Defense Tower - 150 VM;
Posts - only 50 VM.

Overall, a Clan can earn max. 10.000 Victory Medals during each Siege, provided that all opponent’s buildings were destroyed to the ground and your own - remained uncaptured. 

Let’s move to the Victory Points.  They are needed only for matchmaking and for moving from one Tier to another.
In short, Clan members earn Victory Points for each victory in attack or defense. But keep in mind, that you won’t get any points for rebattling victories within Mana Shrines.

If you haven't checked the feature guide in the game yet, it's about time. Open Siege, find the Information sign “i,” and dive into reading.  

A Bit Of Nuance In Matchmaking. 

It is a rare case, but it can happen. Each Siege Tier should contain an even number of Clans -  it is a rule. Since Siege Tiers are not limited by the number of players, sometimes, the number of Clans in a Tier will be odd. In this case, the game will match one of the weakest Clans from the higher Tier with one of the strongest Clans from the lower Tier. 
Clans will get the rewards according to the Tiers where they are currently placed because the only way how you can move to the higher Tier is to increase your Victory Points.

Draw: When Clans Are Performing At The Same Level 

As you know, to win a Siege, your Clan must destroy the enemy’s Stronghold and earn more Victory Medals. If both clans have the same amount of VM by the end of the battle Phase, it is considered a draw, so both clans lose. In short, you must overrun your opponent to win. 

Developers are aware that Clans are concerned about such cases and how often they may happen, and are carefully monitoring the statistics to see if they can grow into an issue. 

ATK Scrolls And No Ability To Use Them 

Clans have more ATK scrolls than required to cover all locations and defeat all defense teams in Siege. If, for various reasons, some players can not participate in the battles in the first few hours after the Battle Phase starts, they might have no chance to use their scrolls, which will eventually prevent them from receiving milestone rewards. The situation is unpleasant, and our developers are analyzing it and looking for possible solutions so that all Clan members have a chance to use the scrolls. 

Ninja duplicates for new players

A few players managed to claim 2 Ninjas. It was a deviation, which we addressed, and extra Ninjas were removed. There can be only 1 Ninja in each gaming account. 

The next Clan vs Clan Tournament (July  30th - August 1st) will be with Personal Rewards - 
Good luck and have fun!


That's pretty much it for today's RAID Digest. 

Have a great weekend, Raiders!

notes.title: New Update: Version 9.00.0
notes.content:
With update 9.00.0, we are adding a highly requested, brand-new game mode for Clans, as well as introducing some fixes. See the full breakdown below!

Siege

On Thursday, July 11, we’re launching the first Siege! It is a new game mode where Clans defend their own Clan Fortress while simultaneously attacking one owned by another Clan. The Clan that destroys their enemy’s Stronghold and earns the most Victory Medals will be declared the winner.

There are four Siege Phases: Prep, Matchmaking, Battle, and Results Calculation. The Prep Phase for a Siege will always last for about 12 days, with this first one starting on July 11. During this Phase, the main focus of your Clan is to upgrade any buildings in your Clan Fortress, set Defense Teams in them, and then set the particular Bonuses and Conditions that will apply across the Clan Fortress. 

There are 5 kinds of buildings in the Clan Fortress: the Stronghold, Posts, Mana Shrines, Magic Towers, and Defense Towers, each with their own specific features. Every Clan Fortress has the same layout and number of buildings. All Clans start their first Siege with their Clan Fortress in the same condition.

After the Prep Phase ends, the Matchmaking Phase will begin. It will last less than a day, and it’s where your Clan’s opponent will be chosen.

To take part in Matchmaking, your Clan must meet the following requirements:


 At least 15 of your Clan’s Members must have reached level 45
 Your Clan must have earned at least 50 Clan Activity Stars during the 7 days before the start of the Matchmaking Phase
 Your Clan must have set at least 15 Defense Teams in the Clan Fortress during the Prep Phase


During your Clan’s first Siege, the game will distribute the Clan into a Siege Tier in accordance with their performance in the last 4 CvC Tournaments. Starting from the 2nd Siege, the game will match Clans depending on the number of Victory Points they have earned from Sieges. Victory Points are given for each victory (either ATK or DEF) a Clan member earns during a Siege. A Clan’s Siege Tier determines how many Victory Points Clan Members earn during a Siege from winning battles, defending buildings and so on. It will also determine the rewards your Clan will receive for winning a Siege.

Once the opponent is found, the Battle Phase will begin, and will last 2 days. During this Phase, you will attack enemy Defense Teams in enemy buildings and observe attacks on your Clan Fortress from your opponent.

The winner will be determined during the Results Calculation Phase. To win a Siege, the Clan must complete 2 objectives:


 Destroy the enemy’s Stronghold
 Earn more Victory Medals than the enemy Clan. Victory Medals are given for destroying enemy buildings, or if any of your Clan’s buildings remain undestroyed at the end of the Battle Phase


If at least one of these conditions is not met, a Clan cannot be declared the winner. If neither Clan is able to achieve these 2 objectives, the Siege is declared a loss for both Clans. 

If the Clan has met the victory conditions, then each Clan Member who achieves at least 1 battle victory during the Siege will receive a Victory Chest. The contents of the Victory Chest depends on what Siege Tier the Clan is currently in, but it will always contain at least one Fragment of a fearsome new Legendary Champion - Authoratrix Lamasu. You can also receive Milestone Rewards as your Clan collects Victory Medals.

And that’s just a brief overview of Siege! For more details, check the guide which can be accessed via the Info button in your Clan’s Fortress window.

Improvements and battle fixes


 Fixed a bug that caused [Poison Cloud] buffs to be affected by the Increase Buff Duration effect.
 Fixed a bug that caused Fyr-gun Isbeil’s Explosive Phoenix P skill to not activate if an enemy died from a Bomb debuff placed and detonated by Isbeil’s Fyrshot skill.
 Fixed a bug that caused a Champion wearing the Guardian Artifact Set to absorb 10% of the damage their allies received from Poison and HP Burn debuffs.
 Fixed a bug that caused battles against Akumori the Phantom Shogun on Auto to end with an error when Skytouched Shaman’s Bloodstain Ritual P skill activated.
 Fixed a visual bug on iOS that caused the “Bronze”, “Silver”, and “Gold” text to not appear at the top of the Clan League Info window.
 Fixed a visual bug that caused the Clan Insignia window to not display correctly.
 Fixed a visual bug that caused visual effects from the Tournaments, Events, and offer icons to briefly appear in the Sparring Pit when opened.
 Fixed a visual bug that caused the backgrounds of the Awakening tab in the Altar of Souls and the Champions window to be displayed incorrectly, if the Awakening tab was opened immediately after opening the Soulstone Summon tab.
 Fixed a bug that caused scrolling issues in the Faction Guardians tab of the Guardian Ring and Mystic Hand to not appear in the list of available Dark Elf Faction Guardians, even when present in a player’s Collection.
 Fixed a bug that caused the ‘[Player name] left this Clan’ message to appear in the Clan Chat if a player’s application to join was rejected.
 Fixed incorrect number formats and roundings in the Shop.
 Fixed a bug that caused additional damage dealt by the Slayer Artifact Set to be capped at 10% of the target’s MAX HP, even if the wearer’s skill did not deal damage based on the target’s MAX HP.
 Other minor bug fixes.

notes.title: New Update: Version 8.60.0
notes.content:
With Update 8.60.0, we are adding a new Divinity with new Blessings, introducing Gear Presets, rebalancing Bosses, and more. See the full breakdown below.

New Divinity - Harmony

We’re adding a new Divinity - Harmony - along with 6 new Blessings. As the name may suggest, these Blessings are about bringing balance to the battlefields of Teleria, and we can’t wait to see how you’ll use them.

Gear Presets

We are adding Gear Presets to the Fitting Room, allowing you to save various Gear combos and equip them with just a few taps. Quickly switching between Gear Presets can be especially useful for taking on the Cursed City, where different districts require different tactics.

Free Gear Removal Boost

We’re introducing a new type of booster - Free Gear Removal - which allows you to swap or remove Gear with no Silver cost for a certain amount of time. While there is an existing booster of a similar kind, this one works on a personal level and not on a server level, meaning you can choose when you want to activate it. Also, this booster will always reduce the Silver cost by 100%. We will still be activating the server-wide Gear Removal Cost reduction boosters, so be sure not to use them at the same time or it’ll go to waste.

Bosses rebalance (Iron Twins, Al-Naemeh, Akumori)

We’re decreasing the stats for the Iron Twins (HP, DEF, RES, ACC), Al-Naemeh the Sand Devil (HP, DEF, RES, ACC), and Akumori the Phantom Shogun (HP, ATK, DEF, SPD, RES, ACC). Also, we are rebalancing some of their skills - see the full breakdown below.

New version: Whenever the Iron Twins’ HP drops below 80%, 60%, and 40%, removes all debuffs from the Iron Twins, then instantly attacks all enemies.

Al-Naemeh the Sand Devil

[Skill 4 – Rest for the Wicked [P]]

- Skill changed: Now the innate damage reduction is decreased by 15% for each debuff that Al-Naemeh is currently under, instead of 10%.

[Skill 5 – Soul Sustenance [P]]

Sand Devil’s Necropolis:

Whenever the Shade counter reaches 20, Akumori will also not receive damage from [HP Burn] debuffs and [Smite] debuffs. notes.title: New Update: Version 8.50.0
notes.content:
New Update: Version 8.50.0

Tavern and Clan improvements, Epic Empowerment, and more!

With update 8.50.0, we are streamlining upgrading Champions, adding Epic Empowerment, rebalancing Champions, and more. See the full breakdown below.

Tavern Improvements

We have made some improvements to the Tavern, making it easier than ever to upgrade your Champions. We’ve also added the Champion Filter to the Tavern to help find the Champions you want to upgrade.

Instant Upgrade

We are introducing the Instant Upgrade function that lets you instantly upgrade a Champion's level using Common and Uncommon Champions of Rank 2 or lower. Once you tick the Instant Upgrade checkbox in the Tavern, the game will filter your Champion list to ensure that it only selects Champions that meet the criteria and can be sacrificed.

The following will not be selected:


 Locked Champions
 Champions that can be used to Fuse another Champion, if they have warnings turned on
 Common and Uncommon Champions of Rank 3 or higher
 Champions with Tags applied
 Champions who are currently in Classic or Tag Team Arena Defense
 Champions who are currently in the Sparring Pit
 Champions who are currently in Saved Teams


You can also manually deselect Champions from the list by tapping on them.

Instant Rank Up

Instant Rank Up allows you to increase the Rank of several Champions at once, via the Instant Rank Up button in the Tavern. In the Instant Rank Up window, you can see Champions who can be instantly ranked up as well as Champions and Chickens that will be used as rank up material.

The following Champions will not be used as Rank Up material:


 Locked Champions
 Champions that can be used to Fuse another Champion, if they have warnings turned on
 Champions who are currently in the Sparring Pit
 Champions who are assigned as Faction Guardians
 Champions who are currently in the Master or Reserve Vault
 Empowered Champions
 Champions who are currently in Classic or Tag Team Arena Defense
 Champions who have reached maximum level in their current Rank


You can use a special Filter to set rules as to which Champions can be used as Rank Up material and in which order they will be chosen. You can find more information in the Instant Rank up guide, which can be accessed via the Info button in the Instant Rank Up window.

Skill upgrade improvements

All Skill Tomes of a certain rarity are now stored in one slot. When upgrading Champion’s skills, you can use a slider to set the number of Skill Tomes you want to use. You can also use the MAX button to use the maximum number of available Skill Tomes.

Champion Ascension improvements

When Ascending a Champion, you can now upgrade several Ascension levels at once using a slider or the MAX button.

Champion Filter

The Champion Filter is now available in the Tavern, allowing you to view all Champions in both Vaults, upgrade them, or use them as upgrade material.

Epic Empowerment

We’ve added the ability to empower Epic Champions! Now, Epic Champions as well as Legendary and Mythical Champions, can be Empowered using their own duplicates. Empowering Champions makes them significantly stronger by giving them permanent Stat boosts.

Redesigned News window

We’ve redesigned the News window so that it now has 2 tabs: Featured News and General News. The Featured News tab will display more important news so you won’t miss anything important. 

Expanded immunity list for Bosses

We’ve added the [Enfeeble] debuff to each Boss’ list of immunities, making them all immune to that debuff. 

Clan improvements

We’ve added a new Clan role - Lieutenant - as well as some quality-of-life improvements. One of those improvements focuses on allowing those with a specific role in a Clan to send a recruitment message to the Global Chat.

Numbers UX update

Numbers above 99,999 are now rounded using letters K (for thousands), M (for millions), and B (for billions) throughout the game UI. Number formats (dots, spaces, and commas) are also adjusted according to the rules of each in-game language.

The HP sacrifice will happen even if it kills this Champion.

New version: Attacks all enemies.

Also heals all allies by 20% of this Champion's MAX HP.

Restores 100% of each ally's destroyed MAX HP, then heals all allies by 20% of this Champion's MAX HP.

Other improvements and battle fixes
